The '''List of Ideologies''' is a local review index for ideology names preserved from the extracted source list.

This page is not a final political taxonomy. It keeps source-listed ideologies connected while the 1994-back port separates established pre-1994 doctrines from later or name-only branches.

== Source Limits ==

The source table includes a typo, "Taosim," for the parent of Revolutionary Taoism. Current drafts treat that as [[Taoism]].

Later source pages also describe Daxaism, Uniterism, and Ultravisionary Taoism. Daxaism is source-described as a 2010s development and is not part of the 1994-back political chronology. Uniterism has post-1994 citation context and no confirmed pre-1994 AGGSWorld anchor in this pass. Ultravisionary Taoism is preserved separately as a modern Taoist trajectory, but its advanced technology claims are not hardened as pre-1994 facts.
